title: Round 3 · v3
meta: a third, fresh critic · 8 fps at the climax, dog crops, frame differences, sound by measurement
gap: The last image of the dog: chin on the floor, but the neck stands up behind it like a plank with the collar on it, for 5 s. And only a fifth of the dog lies outside the jamb, so it reads as lying in the doorway, not across the sill.
repair: Every 8 fps frame from 58 to 63 s: the neck joins head to shoulders with no gap and the collar below the shoulder line; at 320 px, a quarter of the dog on each side of the jamb's outer edge; the dog's tag clear of the threshold tag.
notes: The climax passed three of the four checks from round 2: the head comes up toward the light and holds 10 frames, the tail sweeps twice, the chin goes down within 1.5 s and stays down.
53.5–63 s: the dog's tag covers the threshold tag.
31.6 s: the sit is still a two-frame drop.
33.4 s: getting up re-arranges the head in one frame.
14.5 and 17.5 s: the half-faded title muddies the person and the door.
69 s: grey sublines on the diagram too small for a phone.
Resolved from round 2: the reframes now read as one continuous push-in; no text collisions at 6.3 or 24.75 s.
keep: The lineage reading at 1 fps; refusal and its consequence; the approach staging; the ear-prick and settle at the climax; legible credits.
done: Chin down now brings the neck base down to the chest; the sill moved so a third of the dog lies outside the jamb, which is drawn over it; the dog's tag sits below the threshold tag; the sit is slower and in two phases; faster title fades; bigger diagram sublines; a flick and a sigh answer "come in".

figs.cap: The critic's sheet: the clean pose at 57.25 s and the broken neck at 60.0 s in v3.
